name: Tide Text
description: An outlined headline that holds water inside its letters, with a moving surface that sloshes when the level changes.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real text laid out by the page in the inherited font; the outline and the water are painted over it in the same shapes.

props.name: value
props.description: Water level from 0 (empty) to 100 (full), measured over the height of the letters. When set, it controls the level and scroll is ignored. The level follows with a spring, and the surface sloshes as it moves.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Without a value, fill as the headline is scrolled up through its scrolling container, or the window: empty when it has just come into view at the bottom, full when it reaches the top.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water. It deepens toward the bottom of each line. The outline takes the text colour.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, an inline block. Other span props are passed through. Under reduced motion the plain text is shown.
